description: bulk_redirects.stageRedirects (PUT /v1/bulk-redirects): (1) the live API requires `teamId` in the REQUEST BODY — a body without it fails 400 `validation_error` ("projectId and teamId are required") even when teamId is in the query string, and body-only teamId succeeds (both probed 2026-08-13). The spec declares teamId both as a query parameter and a required body property; the converter dedupes same-named members in favor of the query param, silently dropping the body member. Remove the query parameter so the body member survives codegen. (2) The live API returns 404 `not_found` for a deleted project — add the 404 response for a typed NotFound.
